adaptations: All clinic reads and writes use the M15 ClinicClient and exact registered routes; Dental SaaS HTTP/auth transport was not copied.
Lab request procedure, tooth scope, shade and clinical note are immutable after submission; only the separate reception note is editable.
Pending requests are assigned through POST /v1/lab-orders/:id/assign. Receipt and fit updates use revision-controlled PATCH commands; the Worker supplies transition dates when omitted.

Cancellation is an audited status change with its reason in receptionNote. Only sent or received orders can be cancelled; cancelled history cannot be restored, and pending/fitted orders do not expose cancellation.

Lab suppliers remain records in the shared Finance supplier directory. New entries are lab-only. A lab-only role cannot edit suppliers shared with Finance; finance.manage is required for supplierType=both.
The Lab Supplier Record shows operational lab orders and supplier contact details only; it does not display balances, statements, payments, or purchase ledger data.
Conflicting revisions refresh from the Worker. Uncertain writes retain the original ClinicCommand and idempotency key until its receipt is confirmed.
